reasoning: On the season so far the Bulls are the stronger team; with home court the Bulls start about 3 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Hornets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Bulls win 53 times in 100; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.

analyst.text: Chicago are without their two leading scorers, Norman Powell (mild right hamstring strain) and rookie Caleb Wilson (broken right hand), though they just beat Cleveland 122-108 behind 20 threes. Charlotte are home and slumping, missing Grayson Allen. Chicago's depleted scoring leans this one slightly Charlotte.
